entities.name: PolC DNA polymerase
observations: 768-aa query matched three PolC_DP2 Pfam models: PF03833 positions 12–281 (i-Evalue 1.6e-120), PF24844 positions 309–685 (2e-124), and PF24846 positions 709–766 (1.1e-19).
Sequence search top hit A4G0G9 had 100% identity and 100% query coverage, but only 67.9% target coverage; functional annotation transfer was insufficient.

Likely family-level assignment: bacterial family-C DNA polymerase (PolC), involved in chromosomal DNA replication; exact catalytic activity, organism, and localization were not directly annotated by the analysis.

entities.name: Bacterial DNA replication
observations: PolC-family assignment suggests a role in bacterial chromosome DNA replication; this is a family-level inference, not a directly retrieved annotation for this exact query.
